identificationModule.briefTitle: Changes in Breast 3D Ultrasound Measurements Using Toremifene
identificationModule.officialTitle: Volume and Circulation Changes of The Breast in 3D Ultrasound During Toremifene Versus Nonmedicated Menstrual Cycle

descriptionModule.briefSummary: To investigate if there are detectable changes in volume and circulation in breasts of healthy volunteers using toremifene 20 mg in luteal phase of the menstruation cycle versus nonmedicated cycle.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: 20 women were participated to this trial.

interventions.name: Toremifene
interventions.description: 20mg toremifene per day in tablet form starting from the cycle day 15 and continued to premenstrual period. Medication using about 10 days per volunteer

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* age 25-45 healthy person
* regular menstrual cycles
* safe contraception(for example sterilization or condom)

Exclusion Criteria:

* gynecological or other type of cancer
* hormonal contraception
* pregnancy
